Telecommunication Engineering

Systems thinking, from networks to applications.

Good digital systems need more than individual components. They need reliable connections, useful data, and a clear understanding of the processes they support.

My background spans network security integration, Python-based machine learning, cloud-connected applications, and enterprise infrastructure planning. Across academic projects and an internship, I've learned to move between technical detail and the bigger system.

I'm interested in applying that foundation to Human Capital digital transformation at PT Pertamina—supporting secure information flows, analytical reporting, and dependable digital workflows.

My experience is in engineering projects and infrastructure planning. Human Capital is the application area I'm pursuing; professional HRIS delivery is not claimed.

Enterprise Security Integration & Centralized Monitoring

Connecting firewall events and endpoint telemetry into one monitoring workflow.

pfSenseWazuhSnortWindows VM
  • Verified pfSense and Windows agent connectivity in Wazuh.
  • Detected an Nmap network scan in the monitoring event logs.
  • Documented file integrity monitoring configuration.
Explore case study ↗
01

Situation

Firewall and endpoint events needed a common monitoring view in a virtual security lab.

02

Task & contribution

Integrate pfSense with Wazuh, enable intrusion detection, and document testing. I participated in the three-person project; the report does not allocate individual tasks.

03

Action

The team configured remote logging and Wazuh agents, enabled Snort on LAN/WAN interfaces, adjusted custom pfSense rules in Wazuh, and used Nmap from a Windows VM to simulate a network scan. The report also documents Windows file integrity monitoring configuration and LLDP troubleshooting.

04

Result & evidence

The report records connected agents and successful scan detection in Wazuh. It documents configuration steps for FIM but leaves vulnerability-scan findings unanswered; no quantified threat-reduction result is claimed.

Relevance to Human Capital Systems & Analytics

Centralized visibility, event integration, and change monitoring provide a technical foundation for protecting enterprise information systems, including future Human Capital systems. This was a security lab, with no employee-data or HRIS implementation.

Source notes & limitations

Source discrepancy: the CV names Suricata; the report documents Snort. Logging examples mention both ports 514 and 1514, so no definitive port configuration is asserted.

PREDICTIVE ANALYTICS · 202402

Machine Learning-Based Intrusion Detection

Turning IoT network records into an evaluated classification pipeline.

PythonPandasScikit-learnMatplotlib
  • Prepared 148,517 records with 23 input features.
  • Compared Random Forest with Gradient Boosting.
  • Reported 99.51% Random Forest test accuracy.
Explore case study ↗
01

Situation

An IoT intrusion dataset contained network activity requiring classification into attack and non-attack labels.

02

Task & contribution

Build and compare two classifiers using a reproducible evaluation workflow. I contributed to the four-person academic project; the source does not assign individual ownership of each pipeline stage.

03

Action

The documented pipeline used Pandas, LabelEncoder for protocol_type, service, and flag, and separation of the attack target. A 70/30 split with random_state=42 produced 103,961 training rows and 44,556 test rows. Random Forest and Gradient Boosting were compared through accuracy, precision, recall, F1, confusion matrices, and ROC-AUC.

04

Result & evidence

Random Forest achieved 99.51% accuracy and 0.9997 ROC-AUC; Gradient Boosting achieved 98.62% and 0.9985. The Random Forest confusion matrix reports 23,016 true negatives, 21,323 true positives, 86 false positives, and 131 false negatives. These are reported offline test results, not independently rerun measurements or evidence of live deployment.

Relevance to Human Capital Systems & Analytics

Data preparation, reproducible model comparison, and interpretation of classification errors transfer to analytics and decision support. Applying similar methods to workforce data would require separate data, validation, privacy controls, and domain review.

Source notes & limitations

The ROC figure rounds Random Forest AUC to 1.00; the detailed output is 0.9997043, displayed here as 0.9997. Encoding occurs before splitting in the report; a future pipeline should fit transformations on training data only. The dataset origin is not specified beyond the IoT Intrusion Dataset label.

APPLICATION INTEGRATION · 202503

KiraUangKU — AI-Powered Currency Recognition

An image-to-result experience connecting a web interface, an API, and a detection model.

Next.jsFlaskYOLOv8Docker
  • Connected image uploads to a Flask /detect endpoint.
  • Prepared 290 currency images from an initial 299.
  • Documented JSON detection results and total-value display.
Explore case study ↗
01

Situation

Recognizing banknote denominations and summing their value from images required both machine learning and an accessible user interface.

02

Task & contribution

Develop an end-to-end currency recognition application for a connected services and cloud computing course. I co-developed the two-person project; individual frontend, backend, and model responsibilities are not separated in the report.

03

Action

Images from Roboflow were auto-oriented and resized to 640 × 640, annotated, and exported as TXT labels and YAML configuration. YOLOv8 training ran in Google Colab and produced best.pt. A Dockerized Flask backend on Hugging Face Spaces handled /detect requests from the Next.js frontend on Vercel, returning detections and the total in JSON. GitHub-managed updates supported deployment.

04

Result & evidence

The report includes upload, preview, detection, and calculated-total interfaces. It documents 290 images used from 299 collected. No aggregate model accuracy, production latency, or business efficiency metric is reported.

Relevance to Human Capital Systems & Analytics

API contracts, frontend/backend communication, containerization, and automated processing transfer to internal digital applications and workflow automation. Currency recognition is the demonstrated use case.

Source notes & limitations

The report includes an AI-generated UI prompt with mock predictions for prototyping. Its result screenshots are presented as source artifacts, not as independently verified model performance.

Enterprise Infrastructure Planning & Business Continuity

Documenting resilient connectivity and recovery priorities for critical digital services.

SD-WANHigh AvailabilityBCMBIA · RTO · RPO

Explore case study ↗
01

Situation

Pelindo's digital services required resilient regional connectivity and a structured approach to service continuity.

02

Task & contribution

Support the Digital Infrastructure and Security division at PT Integrasi Logistik Cipta Solusi, identified in the CV as Pelindo Digital Solution, during 1 July–29 August 2025. My work focused on analysis, planning, documentation, and guided review.

03

Action

I prepared project timelines and BoQ documentation involving PA-1410, PA-440, and Panorama M-300; drew branch topologies with hybrid Internet/MPLS and HA firewalls; and participated in the IPC TPK Tanjung Priok 2 survey. I analyzed proposed fiber-ring and wireless designs, reviewed enterprise application architectures, contributed to BCM guidance referencing ISO 22301:2019, and created an example BIA worksheet covering impact and recovery priorities.

04

Result & evidence

Documented outputs include planning artifacts, network topologies, BCM policy contributions, and a BIA filling guide. The proposed wireless design includes 22 directional and 17 omnidirectional access points. This describes planning scope, not 39 personally deployed devices, measured uptime gains, or verified production implementation.

Relevance to Human Capital Systems & Analytics

Dependency mapping, recovery objectives, technical coordination, and impact analysis are relevant to the reliability of enterprise Human Capital services and their supporting infrastructure.

Source notes & limitations

The report uses the legal name PT Integrasi Logistik Cipta Solusi and the commercial name Pelindo Solusi Digital; the CV uses Pelindo Digital Solution. No production improvements are attributed to the internship.
